digest.component_or_area: live jira data center integration & store reconciliation
propositions: rebar reconciles bidirectionally against a real DC instance with zero unhandled exceptions, proven live with a complete copy of the project's actual ticket store
the store copy is isolated by design: a fresh repo with no remotes, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credentials, and zero .bridge_state* artifacts survive the scrub

every mutation (create, edit, transition, link, assign, parent, delete) in both inbound and outbound directions is asserted individually by oracle to round-trip, with idempotence verified per-direction
pagination is exercised by seeding 2*observed_page_size+1 issues and measuring full recovery, independent of pagination-unaware local store copy
DC platform constraints on parent/assignee operations are measured distinctly from product defects via setup assertions and raw-REST verification
